dormitory.note: Seoul Campus GlobeeDorm (국제학사) 입사관리비 per semester (4 months): 3-person room 953,000 / 2-person room 1,191,000 KRW, plus 30,000 deposit and 10,000 dorm-council fee; meals not included; capacity 662 incl. exchange and government-invited scholars. Other halls: Seoul GLOBAL HALL 기숙사비 1,949,000 (1st sem ~24 wk) / 2,111,000 (2nd sem half-year ~26 wk) + 관리비, with a 35% quota for 외국인 및 재외국민 (s15); Global Campus HUFS Dorm 입사비 600,000 (4-person) to 1,244,000 (2-person), 외국인(외국국적) listed under 우선선발 (s16).
